title: mcp.server.ts keeps a module-level let makeAdapter that tests swap through setAdapterFactory and must reset after every case.
evidence: (a) app/lib/mcp.server.ts:96 declares let makeAdapter = REAL_ADAPTER (:93-94). setAdapterFactory (:98-100) replaces it, and null restores the real one. Nothing else runs at import. (b) The only production reader is callHostedTool at :268, reached from mcpEndpoint (:576), which app/routes/mcp.$.tsx:152 and :320 call. Writers are tests only: mcp.hosted, mcp.google, mcp.hosted-guards, mcp.knowledge and mcp.reviewer tests, plus tools/assistant-injection.test.ts:111, each pairing set with setAdapterFactory(null) in afterEach. mcp.hosted-guards.test.ts:617-631 must call resetModules and set the seam again on a second module instance. (c) Owner: pass the factory in, e.g. createMcpEndpoint({makeAdapter}) built once in app/routes/mcp.$.tsx with the real factory and per test with a MemoryAdapter (a suggested shape). setAdapterFactory, the let and every afterEach reset could then go. (d) Risk: a test that throws before its reset, or forgets it, leaks a fake adapter into later cases in the same worker. Since the seam is per module instance, a resetModules quietly drops it.
